rules.probability: Poisson from expected rushing plus receiving touchdowns. Relatively safe starts at 22%. 2+ is upside only at 12% or higher, and 3+ only at 6%. Below that, down to 4%, the label is Long shot. The Week 12 tier check is three finished games. Team totals use season scoring, not a sportsbook total. estimate=true means fewer than 4 games.
